text:
Based on the onboarding guide, **in-tree memory additions are closed**, so a direct PR to add `plugins/memory/yantrikdb/` to the repository will not be accepted.

Instead, you should build YantrikDB as a standalone plugin:
1. Develop it under `~/.hermes/plugins/` (e.g., `~/.hermes/plugins/yantrikdb/`).
2. Activate it using the command: `hermes plugins enable <name>`.
